description: Cross-binding simulation gate for problems/growth_sectional_lr2m_mms.esm (sectional condensational growth, cell 1 growing and cell 2 shrinking, geometric size grid, closed size range) on the default NBIN = 8 grid, under growth_lr2m_D_bin_closed and growth_lr2m_tracer_D_bin_closed: every simulating binding runs the problem's two inline tests and must agree on the verdicts. mms_sectional_growth_both_directions: the ic wiring at t = 0, the bounded relative L2 errors of the section number N at t = 0.2 and of the volume-carried m at t = 0.1, and conservation of each cell's total number to round-off at t = 0.2. closed_ends_conserve_number: conservation of each cell's total number at t = 1, after both bumps have left the size range and piled up against its closed ends.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.python: Too slow: the python conformance job is disabled on main because the python runner no longer finishes inside the CI job limit against esm 2.x (.github/workflows/conformance.yml); this case's problem is the one whose convergence sweep python could not finish. Re-arm, with an LSODA tolerance as tight as the 1e-13 / 1e-15 the other bindings use, once the python binding is fast enough to run in CI.
